summary: Caruaru's official municipal Cadastro Imobiliário Fiscal/Territorial was evidenced as the local cadastral custodian. Public anonymous inspection reached the city portal, citizen-services portal, legislative records, procurement notices, and the SEFAZ system login page, but did not retrieve parcel geometry or a safe native parcel identity.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Documented in city-8482-caruaru.json under freshResearch, officialSources, and requests. English and Portuguese discovery were separate. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe fields were used.
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-8.28267201513391, -35.9712887605926] was not shifted and was not used to claim a parcel hit or miss.
No public parcel feature endpoint, schema response, native parcel ID, or geometry was verified.
The official SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone 25 reference came from a municipal technical document, not a parcel feature response.
Administrative cadastral-system evidence is not source integration/admission and does not prove citywide public parcel coverage.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
